notes.subject: ניחוחין
notes.rationale: Aramaic 'pleasing-rest odours' — ofa bilong paia we i gutpela win; 'sweet savours' em i bin tanim long pasin bilong ofa.

notes.subject: ומצלין
notes.rationale: מצלי = pre — 'ol i ken sing out/save long Yahwe', tasol D2 i makim profet pasin; pre em i namba tu reading.

translation: Olsem na ol i ken olsem givim ofa ol i kukim olgeta we i gutpela win bilong en i go long Eloa bilong heven, na ol i ken autim tok profet bilong laip bilong king na bilong ol pikinini man bilong en.
